page.title: Awesome AI
page.intro: A curated list of AI tools organized by what you want to do. Each entry links to the official site or repository.

tools.chatgpt: Draft and revise text, brainstorm ideas, and ask follow-up questions.
tools.claude: Work through long documents and rewrite drafts with specific feedback.
tools.gemini: Ask questions about text and images or turn notes into a first draft.
tools.copilot: Get inline code suggestions and ask questions inside your editor.
tools.cursor: Navigate a codebase in an editor that can propose coordinated edits across files.
tools.continue: Use configurable coding assistance with your choice of model.
tools.perplexity: Search the web and follow source links to check the answer.
tools.notebooklm: Ask questions and make study notes using the sources you collect.
tools.elicit: Find relevant research papers and extract findings into a comparison table.
tools.firefly: Generate image concepts and fill or replace selected areas of an image.
tools.ideogram: Create images that incorporate text for posters and graphics.
tools.comfyui: Build reusable image generation workflows with a node editor.
tools.whisper: Transcribe audio recordings locally using an open-source speech model.
tools.elevenlabs: Turn scripts into spoken narration and produce dubbed audio.
tools.runway: Generate short video clips from text prompts or still images.
tools.notion: Summarize notes and draft documents within your Notion workspace.
tools.zapier: Add steps that classify or summarize text to automations across apps.
tools.n8n: Connect apps, APIs, and language models in a visual workflow editor.
